title: vsp --browser-auth panics 'close of closed channel' right after SSO redirect
symptom: vsp prints 'SSO redirect in progress' (or 'error reading cookies: chrome failed to start') then 'panic: close of closed channel' in chromedp allocate.go within seconds.
rootCause: chromedp cannot start its browser: default Edge auto-detect fails, and a running Chrome instance can block it even with --browser-exec Chrome.

solutions.label: Close Chrome, use --browser-exec Chrome
solutions.body: Get-Process chrome must be 0 (ask the user, never kill it), pass --browser-exec "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" and --browser-auth-timeout 5m. Never pipe through head.

prevention: sap-doctor step 3 checks Chrome before running the refresh.
evidence: this session 2026-10-05: Chrome closed -> both tenants 'Authentication successful! Extracted 2 cookies'
